description: A card table of quartered walnut with a board inlaid flush into its top: ebony and holly, each square a separate piece of wood, the grain running the same way across all sixty-four. The set kept beside it is weighted rosewood and boxwood, the kings collared in a thin band of tarnished silver. Everything about it is quiet and very old and worth more than the chairs, which are themselves worth more than most people's month.
name: Inlaid Chess Table
